title: 第18章 都给我住手
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
梅兰山庄，一栋装修奢华的别墅大堂里。

    柳醉梅斜倚在黑色的真皮沙发上，一身剪裁大胆的酒红色吊带睡裙，裙摆堪堪遮住大腿，露出一双白皙修长的玉腿，脚上踩着一双红色的高跟拖鞋。

    她长发松松地挽起，几缕碎发垂落在脸颊旁，眉眼间带着几分慵懒与性感，正低头专注地看着手机。

    她指尖在屏幕上轻轻滑动，脸色看不出喜怒，只是眉宇间隐隐透着一丝复杂。

    就在这时，一阵急促的脚步声传来。

    桃夭快步走到她身前，一身干练的黑色西装，神色凝重，微微躬身说：“梅姐，已经查清楚了，那个陈阳，目前就在合成酒店做厨师，住在阳光小区出租楼。

    表面上看没什么特殊的，就是个普通的年轻人。”

    柳醉梅抬眸，放下手机，眼神平静说：“一般修炼者都习惯低调，隐在都市中过着普通人的生活，也算是正常。”

    她顿了顿，语气陡然一转，带着几分命令，“桃夭，你带点人立刻去江河别墅区8号别墅，帮陈阳解救他的朋友。”

    桃夭闻言，猛地吃了一惊，脸上露出难以置信的神色，连忙说：“梅姐，8号别墅住的可是……

    可是肖明枭的弟弟肖明轩，我们这么做，会不会……”

    柳醉梅轻轻点了点头，语气平淡却带着不容置疑的笃定：“我知道，你带过去，尽量不要得罪他弟弟，只要把人救出来就行，别节外生枝。”

    桃夭脸色复杂，虽有万般不愿，但还是只能恭敬地应道：“是，梅姐，我知道了。”

    说完，她转身快步退了出去，迅速召集人手，朝着江河别墅区赶去。

    ……

    与此同时，江河别墅区8号别墅内。

    大厅里一片狼藉，宋萌萌和那个穿着校服的少女被反扭着胳膊，狼狈地站在客厅中央。

    肖明轩坐在主位的沙发上，一脸阴鸷，冲着身边的保镖厉声喊道：“把她们的衣服给我扒了！

    我倒要看看，这两个女人能硬到什么时候！”

    三个保镖应声站起，脸上露出猥琐的笑意，一步步朝着宋萌萌和少女逼近。

    “你们干什么？住手！”宋萌萌吓得脸色惨白，身体控制不住地发抖，声音却依旧带着一丝倔强，“肖明轩，你们还有没有王法？你们这是犯法！我要报警！”
content_en:
Meilan Villa, in the lobby of a luxuriously decorated villa.

Liu Zuimei was reclining on the black leather sofa, wearing a boldly cut burgundy suspender nightgown. The hem of the skirt covered her thighs, revealing a pair of fair and slender legs. On her feet were a pair of red high-heeled slippers.

Her long hair was pulled up loosely, with a few strands of hair hanging down beside her face. There was a bit of laziness and sexiness between her eyebrows, and she was looking down at her phone intently.

Her fingertips slid gently on the screen, her face showing no emotion or anger, but a hint of complexity between her brows.

At this moment, a burst of rapid footsteps came.

Tao Yao walked up to her quickly, wearing a smart black suit with a solemn expression. She bowed slightly and said, "Sister Mei, we have found out that Chen Yang is currently working as a chef in Hehe Hotel and living in a rental building in Sunshine Community.

On the surface, there is nothing special about him, he is just an ordinary young man."

Liu Zuimei raised her eyes, put down her phone, and said calmly: "Most practitioners are used to keeping a low profile, and living an ordinary life hidden in the city is considered normal."

She paused, then her tone suddenly changed, with a hint of command, "Taoyao, take some people to Villa No. 8 in Jianghe Villa District immediately to help Chen Yang rescue his friends."

Tao Yao was startled when she heard this, with a look of disbelief on her face, and she quickly said: "Sister Mei, the person who lives in Villa No. 8 is...

But Xiao Mingxiao’s younger brother Xiao Mingxuan, if we do this, will it..."

Liu Zuimei nodded slightly, her tone calm but with unquestionable certainty: "I know, take him there, try not to offend his brother, just save the person, don't cause trouble."

Tao Yao's face was complicated. Although she was reluctant, she could only respond respectfully: "Yes, Sister Mei, I understand."

After saying that, she turned around and retreated quickly, quickly gathered her people and rushed towards the Jianghe Villa area.

…

At the same time, in Villa No. 8 in Jianghe Villa District.

The hall was in a mess. Song Mengmeng and the girl in school uniform had their arms twisted behind their backs and stood in the middle of the living room in embarrassment.

Xiao Mingxuan sat on the sofa in the main seat, with a sinister look on his face, and shouted sharply at the bodyguards beside him: "Take off their clothes for me!

I want to see how hard these two women can be!"

The three bodyguards stood up in response, with lewd smiles on their faces, and approached Song Mengmeng and the girl step by step.

"What are you doing? Stop!" Song Mengmeng turned pale with fright, her body was shaking uncontrollably, but her voice still had a hint of stubbornness, "Xiao Mingxuan, do you have any other laws? You are breaking the law! I want to call the police!"
